# Lane E fixtures

## `pki/`

Certificates of pyHanko's Certomancer test PKIs (`testing-ca`,
`testing-ca-ecdsa`, `testing-ca-qualified`, `unrelated-tsa`), one PEM file
per certificate label. Produced from
`crates/testdata/data/pyhanko/crypto/certomancer.yml` (pyHanko 0.38.1,
certomancer 0.16.0) with:

    PYTHONPATH=<pyHanko v0.38.1>/internal/common-test-utils/src python crates/eutl/oracle/export_pki.py

Validity periods are fixed in the configuration. No private keys are
exported; the corresponding keys are pyHanko's public test keys under
`data/pyhanko/crypto/keys-*`.

License: MIT (derived from pyHanko test data, see `../../pyhanko/LICENSE-pyHanko`).

## `tl/`

`certomancer-lotl.xml` and `certomancer-qualified-tl.xml`: XAdES-signed
lists generated by pyHanko's test utilities (`certomancer_lotl`,
`certomancer_pki_as_trusted_list`) in the same run as `pki/`, by
`crates/eutl/oracle/export_pki.py`.

## `ades/`

`test_ades_validation*.json`: recordings of pyHanko 0.38.1 running its own
`pkgs/pyhanko/tests/test_ades_validation*.py` modules with
`crates/pades/oracle/record_plugin.py`
(`crates/pades/oracle/run_oracle.sh <python> <pyHanko checkout> <repo>`).
Per test case: the validated objects, frozen validation times, HTTP
exchanges with the Certomancer PKI services, pyHanko's verdicts; per file:
the certificates of the Certomancer architectures used in that run and the
trusted lists generated during the run.
